characters.storyAppearance: Ancient adult elven guardian, black hair, pointed ear with chain woven behind it, bare calf and bare soles, ordinary clothes subject to rain/soot. Exact physical age, face and detailed garment cut unspecified; source-compatible green/gold costume and face drawn from original.
visualInterpretation: Avarra is ONE ancient but physically adult elven woman, art-visible age about thirty, with long loose BLACK hair, clearly POINTED ears, warm olive skin, dark hazel eyes, calm angular face and a gently skeptical expression. Preserve the recognizable face, hair, green/gold clothing family and fine chainwork of the original, but repaint everything in the primary painting's broad oil language. A delicate bronze-gold chain is woven through hair behind a pointed ear; restrained leaf-shaped filigree at the bodice, arm bands and chain necklace are subordinate costume accents, no crown. Her opaque DARK FOREST GREEN fitted sleeveless bodice connects to a layered draped skirt, with the front panels ending below the knees and longer side/back cloth so the BARE CALVES remain visible. BOTH FEET BARE, complete natural toes visible; no shoes, stockings or anklets. Neutral practical upright front and rear stances, unglamorous and unposed, same outfit and adult face in both bodies and portrait. This is the opening autumn circuit state, before rain, soot and later bruising. No saddle, reins, weapons, staff, elk, forest, glowing magic or root diagrams. Her chain and hair are entirely attached to her clothed figure, not isolated details.

characters.name: Winterbough
characters.role: Giant white elk, ancient carrier and autonomous route chooser

selectionEvidence.quote: His shoulder stood half again as high as hers when she was on the ground
One dark eye found her through the pale tines.
selectionEvidence.explanation: Natural dark eye and pale antler tines.

selectionEvidence.quote: There was no bridle to take up, no rein hidden under the long pale shag. There had never been one.
selectionEvidence.explanation: Never add harness or riding equipment.

characters.storyAppearance: Giant male white elk, dense fur and long pale shag, pale antler tines, dark eye, long legs and ordinary cloven forehooves; shoulders half again Avarra's full standing height. No bridle or reins. Thought remains inferred from behaviour, never speaking or visibly magical.
visualInterpretation: Winterbough is ONE enormous male WHITE ELK, ancient but physically vigorous, unbridled and unridden in this reference. Natural elk/deer build with an elongated intelligent-looking head, large mobile ears, dark brown ordinary animal eyes, broad dark muzzle, very long powerful legs, cloven dark hooves and a muscular high shoulder. DENSE LONG WHITE SHAG on the neck, chest and shoulders, with white shorter fur on flanks and long pale shag elsewhere; warm cream highlights and blue-grey connected shadows retain an unmistakably WHITE animal. Source scale: his SHOULDER stands one and a half times Avarra's whole standing height; do not draw a person for scale. Huge branching ANTLERS with PALE BONE-COLOURED TINES; brown-grey grooves at their bases are allowed, but tips must be pale as the prose specifies. Use elk's slender branching multi-tined antler structure, not broad moose paddles or tree trunks. All antler tips fully inside canvas with clear ivory margins. Show TWO complete unclipped forms of THIS SAME animal: a large three-quarter side whole-body view and a slightly smaller forward-facing whole-body view, attentive ears and a patient still stance. No extra head portrait: leave room for the full antlers and all four legs/hooves. Consistent white shag, face and antler branching across both. No human rider, saddle, bridle, rein, harness, collar, ornaments, hanging ivy, decorative lights, glow, spirit double, skeleton, terrain or floor marks. The original supplies head shape and shag only; the dark barklike original antlers are subordinate to the prose's pale tines.
